scope: Small synthetic Qwen35-style affine BF16 expert fixture on real Metal. Not model-serving or memory-fit evidence.
native_routed_first_mismatch: FP32 scores with BF16 activation: max absolute 0.0009765625; corrected Qwen35 score cast in research worktree
sorted_vs_unsorted: 72-route native sorted path diverged at first gate/up projections (gate max 0.01171875, up max 0.0087890625); real native SwitchGLU matched sorted reference exactly
grouped_projection: 256 experts, top-8, tokens 8/127/128/129, BF16/FP16: exact matching in tested bounded grouping and padding cases
grouped_full: 256 experts, top-8, tokens 8/127/128/129, BF16/FP16, promotion off/on and group sizes 16/32/64: exact weighted output in test-only grouped reference
limitations: Tests compare synthetic reference code, not integrated Qwen35 implementation; use full-bank tensor views and do not measure streaming footprint. Qwen4 optional real-bundle test did not load a bundle. Non-page-aligned mapping worked on this host in fixture; supported API behavior is not established. Runtime error propagation, concurrency, long-prefill costs, real-model parity and hardware qualification remain open.
